definition: Knowing and seeing that release has occurred; a standard attainment expression in the awakening sequence.
notes: Use this record when the text explicitly names the knowing and seeing of release. The compound inherits the vimutti, ñāṇa, and dassana headword policies and should not be inflated into vague mystical-experience language.

translation_policy.default_scope: Use this as the standard rendering when a text names the knowing and seeing that release has occurred, keeping vimutti as release and ñāṇadassana as knowing and seeing.
translation_policy.when_not_to_apply: Do not inflate the compound into mystical-experience language, and reserve the knowledge-and-vision alternate for comparative or explanatory prose rather than direct translation.
translation_policy.drift_risk: Prevents a specific attainment expression from becoming vague experience-language, and keeps vimutti from drifting into the freedom and escape renderings the headword discourages.
